Author: @WariamSingh
Content:
some tips about the create mod:
-if you put lava in front of a fan and then make it blow out you can bulk blast stuff and it will smelt them really fast and I'm pretty sure it can do entire stacks at once, you can also place a campfire in front of it for bulk smoking for cooking food, water for bulk washing and a soul campfire for bulk haunting

-if you craft a rotation speed controller and put a large cogwheel on top of it you can make your machines go WAY faster

-in the new create mod update you can make a logistics system to do SO many cool things including making an storage system for accessing all of your stuff in one place and also autocrafting them if you have a mechanical crafter setup (although you might not be updated to the latest version)

- in the last episode you mentioned wanting an elevator, you can actually do that with an elevator pulley and contrapion controls for selecting the floor and also buttons for calling the elevator

-you can make trains

there are many more tips I could give you but I recommend watching a tutorial on it

Content: Create mod tip: crafting bread normally in Minecraft has the ratio of 3 wheat per 1 bread. Author: @markplier5313
Content:
New episode!!!! The two weeks wait is always so long 😭
Tips while watching again 🫡 
-Be careful using the toolbelt (the thing that let's you mine blocks without the tools in hand) as there's been a glitch where it deletes the item you are holding when mining. Make sure to only use it with an empty hand!

-Get a rotational speed controller going!!! It makes it so much easier to speed up your cogs! You just need enough power from wheels and it can speed up to 256 rpm!

-A big part of this pack is exploration! I think im the one who said irons spellbooks would be easier earlier, sorry for not clarifying 😅  The inscryption table is actually very easy to find in magical structures which are also pretty common

-You can also craft a scroll forge using crying obsidian! Using paper, ink, and some of the essences you got you can craft different irons spells!

-Also the dragonbone weapons get even better if you manage to kill a dragon and bottle its blood to add to the weapon! The tools are also very good!
